title: 第897章 隐忍第896章 一城抵一命
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
因为涂山心底无比清楚。
能以天人境修为，炼制瞬杀仙境大能的虚空大杀器。
能让先天剑体的柳惊天甘愿配合出手。
这两人，根本不能以寻常天骄看待。
追杀不成，只会引来更恐怖的反噬。
况且他们最重要的任务还没有完成，现在不是节外生枝的时候。
涂山双拳死死攥紧，压下心中报复的冲动。
“妖庭任务最重要。”
那可是对付星尊的大杀器！
与星尊随便出手，就毁掉一界的狠人相比。
凌宇，柳惊天连毁掉跨界传送大阵都做不到。
这样敌人什么都不是。
与一界相比！
仅仅毁掉四周城池算什么损失！
况且，城池跨界传送大阵还在。
这几座城池早晚还能繁荣起来。
可，星尊不一样。
在他毁掉蜕凡天他们妖族的根基之后。
他与他们妖庭之间的仇恨根本无法和解。
星尊来长生天是迟早的问题。

他们必须在星尊到来之前，布局完成。
片刻功夫，涂山才平复心境。
“传我号令！”
“长生天全境妖族，尽数封域自守！”
“没有允许，严禁任何妖族挑衅太虚宗弟子！”
“严禁招惹凌宇，柳惊天二人！”
“违者，废除妖丹，逐出妖庭，挫骨扬灰！”
冰冷的号令，伴随着浩荡妖威，瞬间传遍长生天所有妖族疆域。
所有妖族，无论大小种族，全部收到警示。
一时间，整片长生天妖族人心惶惶，彻底噤若寒蝉。
再也没有任何一头妖族，胆敢轻视太虚宗，胆敢挑衅人族修士。
与此同时。
天南城，太虚宗驻地。
凌宇与柳惊天安然归来。
两人刚踏入驻地，孙长老以及一众宗门弟子立刻迎了上来。
众人看着两人身上淡淡的杀伐气息，满脸好奇与敬畏。
他们虽不知具体战况。
却能隐约感知到，远方妖族疆域传来的剧烈波动。
孙长老连忙上前，恭敬开口。
“柳师兄，凌峰主，你们安全回来就好！”

这两人一个是一峰之主，一个是掌门弟子。
要是在他这里出了事。
content_en:
Because Tushan knew very well in his heart.
He can use his cultivation in the Heavenly Realm to refine a powerful void killing weapon that can kill instantly in the Immortal Realm.
Liu Jingtian, who had an innate sword body, was willing to cooperate.
These two people cannot be treated as ordinary geniuses at all.
Failure to pursue them will only lead to more terrifying backlash.
Besides, their most important task has not been completed yet, so now is not the time to create extraneous matters.
Tushan clenched his fists tightly and suppressed the urge for revenge in his heart.
"The mission of Demon Court is the most important."
That is a great weapon against Star Lord!
Compared with Xing Zun, a ruthless person who destroys an entire world with just a casual move.
Ling Yu and Liu Jingtian couldn't even destroy the cross-border teleportation formation.
This way the enemy is nothing.
Compared with one world!
Just destroying the surrounding cities is nothing but a loss!
Besides, the city's cross-border teleportation formation is still there.
These cities will prosper sooner or later.
However, Xing Zun is different.
After he destroyed the foundation of Sheofantian and his demon clan.
The hatred between him and their Demon Court cannot be reconciled at all.
It was only a matter of time before Xingzun came to Changshengtian.
They must complete the layout before Star Lord arrives.
It took a moment for Tu Shan to calm down.
"Give me the order!"
"All demon clans in Changshengtian must seal their territory to defend themselves!"
"Without permission, any demon clan is strictly prohibited from provoking Taixu Sect disciples!"
"It is strictly forbidden to provoke Ling Yu and Liu Jingtian!"
"Anyone who violates this rule will have the demon elixir abolished, expelled from the demon court, and their bones shattered into ashes!"
The cold command, accompanied by the mighty demon power, instantly spread throughout all the demon clan territories in Changshengtian.
All demon clans, regardless of their size, have received warnings.
For a moment, the entire Immortal Demon Clan was in panic and completely silent.
No demon clan dared to despise the Taixu Sect or provoke the human monks.
at the same time.
Tiannan City, the residence of Taixu Sect.
Ling Yu and Liu Jingtian returned safely.
As soon as the two stepped into the station, Elder Sun and a group of sect disciples immediately came to greet them.
Everyone looked at the faint murderous aura on the two men, with curiosity and awe on their faces.
Although they don't know the specific battle situation.
But he could vaguely sense the violent fluctuations coming from the distant demon clan territory.
Elder Sun stepped forward quickly and spoke respectfully.
"Senior Brother Liu, Master Ling, just hope you come back safely!"
One of these two people is the master of a peak, and the other is the head disciple.
If something happens to him.
